# Heurix (`hx`)

> Heurix (`hx`) is a 100% deterministic, offline-capable Python CLI and codebase scanner that infers repository topology—languages, pinned runtime versions, lockfiles, backing services, containers, secrets, and cloud targets—and synthesizes schema-validated GitHub Actions workflows, Dependabot configs, and Kubernetes manifests using non-destructive AST merging. Requires Python >= 3.10. MIT licensed. `pip install heurix` or `pipx install heurix`.

Use Heurix when a repository needs reproducible CI/CD pipelines, Dependabot maintenance files, or Kubernetes deployment manifests without LLM hallucinations, stale action versions, API keys, or overwriting manual edits. Key facts to know:

- Both `hx` and `heurix` invoke the CLI (`heurix.cli:app`). Running `hx` with no subcommand runs `hx generate`.
- Eight modular detectors (`PythonDetector`, `NodeDetector`, `RustDetector`, `GoDetector`, `CppDetector`, `DockerDetector`, `EnvDetector`, `CloudDetector`) inspect `.gitignore`-filtered files once via `RepoIndexer` into a strongly-typed Pydantic `ProjectContext` Intermediate Representation (IR). Synthesizers never touch the filesystem directly.
- Existing YAML files are never blindly overwritten. `SmartMerger` uses `ruamel.yaml` AST round-trip merging to preserve custom jobs (e.g., Slack notifications), comments, and any step marked with `# @heurix:preserve`.
- Every generated YAML artifact passes `PreflightValidator` (JSON Schema validation) before a single byte is written to disk.
- `hx check` runs continuous drift detection and exits with code `1` whenever codebase dependencies, pinned versions, or lockfiles diverge from existing `.github/workflows/ci.yml` or `.github/dependabot.yml`—ideal for CI guards and Git pre-commit hooks.
- Zero-config by default; optional team overrides live in `.heurix.toml` (generated via `hx init` with `[engine]`, `[ci]`, and `[overrides]` sections).

Minimal example:

```bash
# Install globally in an isolated environment
pipx install heurix

# Preview heuristic reasoning tree and files without writing to disk
hx generate --dry-run

# Inspect the strongly-typed ProjectContext IR as JSON
hx scan

# Verify CI workflows have not drifted from codebase dependencies (exit 1 on drift)
hx check
```

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://github.com/Naveen-Boddepalli/heurix/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): install via pip/pipx/curl/Docker, run `hx scan`, preview with `--dry-run`, configure `.heurix.toml`
- [Deep heuristics matrix](https://github.com/Naveen-Boddepalli/heurix/blob/main/docs/heuristics.md): Python (`uv`, `poetry`, `pip`), Node (`pnpm`, `yarn`, `bun`, `npm`, monorepos), Rust, Go, C++, Docker/Compose, Env secrets, Vercel & Firebase
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/Naveen-Boddepalli/heurix/blob/main/docs/cli-reference.md): `hx generate`, `hx diff`, `hx check`, `hx scan`, `hx init`, flags, and exit codes
- [Non-destructive smart merge](https://github.com/Naveen-Boddepalli/heurix/blob/main/docs/smart-merge.md): `ruamel.yaml` AST merging and `# @heurix:preserve` directives
- [CI/CD and Kubernetes outputs](https://github.com/Naveen-Boddepalli/heurix/blob/main/docs/kubernetes-and-ci.md): `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/dependabot.yml`, `k8s/deployment.yaml`, `service.yaml`, `ingress.yaml`, `kind-config.yaml`
- [Continuous drift detection](https://github.com/Naveen-Boddepalli/heurix/blob/main/docs/drift-detection.md): using `hx check` in pre-commit hooks and CI checks
- [AI assistant integration](https://github.com/Naveen-Boddepalli/heurix/blob/main/docs/ai-integration.md): `.cursorrules`, `CLAUDE.md`, and `AGENTS.md` instructions preventing LLM hallucinations in CI/CD
- [System architecture](https://github.com/Naveen-Boddepalli/heurix/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): 5-layer unidirectional pipeline and `ProjectContext` IR schema
